name: oeis-mcp-server
description: Search the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS): identify sequences by terms, A-number, formulas, and cross-references.

OEIS_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT_MS.title: Queue wait budget (ms)
OEIS_QUEUE_MAX_WAIT_MS.description: Longest a call waits in the oeis.org request queue (paced to one start per 10 s) before failing with a retry-after. Default 30000.
